artworks.label: Articulated seahorse
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone Glaze small-widget illustration for blueprint-bureau. Square 1024 x 1024. Subject: One entirely original articulated mechanical seahorse in elegant upright side profile, its curved ivory engineering-line silhouette formed from fine ribbed metal plates and miniature hinge joints, curled segmented tail, delicate fan-like fin, a tiny exploded view of two fin parts beside it. No words or measurement marks. Style: Precise cyanotype technical engraving: very fine warm ivory-white linework and restrained pale-cyan crosshatching, continuous delicate engineering contours, no filled brass 3D rendering. Retain deep muted cyan-blue ink-paper tone ONLY inside the object silhouette if needed; background transparent. Match a deep #185A73 cyan-blue drawing-paper wallpaper, existing compass-beetle and technical house, lantern and mechanical nautilus; new seahorse subject. Composition: whole subject centered, clear readable silhouette at small iPhone size, 15 percent clear margins, soft upper-left lighting. True transparent background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, hard rectangular frame, scenery or collage. Pure art only: absolutely NO text, lettering, numerals, dates, calendar, clock hands, dial, UI, logo or watermark. No copy, crop or recolour of any existing piece.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q92 method6; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
